schemes.summary: Income support for eligible landholding farmer families through direct benefit transfer.

benefit.description: ₹6,000 per year, paid in three equal instalments, subject to scheme conditions.

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must belong to a landholding farmer family with cultivable land recorded in the relevant State/UT land records.

exclusions.description: Certain higher-economic-status categories are excluded, including specified constitutional office holders, specified government employees, income-tax payers and specified practising professionals. The exact categories and exceptions must be checked in the official guideline.

required_documents.note: State land-record evidence and data requirements must be confirmed for the applicant's case.
Do not collect or store these in the chatbot demo. The official portal controls identity and payment verification.

process: Check current eligibility and beneficiary status on the official PM-KISAN portal.
Complete the official e-KYC process where required.
Use the official portal or authorised service channel for registration and status checks.
important_current_notes: The official portal states that e-KYC is mandatory for registered PM-KISAN farmers.
The portal describes temporary withholding and physical verification for certain suspected exclusion cases; Gram Saathi must not infer wrongdoing from this.
schemes.review_notes: Before enabling deterministic eligibility decisions, transcribe every exclusion and exception from the current official guideline and confirm Karnataka land-record integration requirements. This record is suitable for discovery/demo, not final eligibility determination.

schemes.summary: Crop insurance for notified crops in notified areas, subject to the season's State notification and scheme rules.

benefit.description: Insurance cover for eligible notified crops and risks. Actual sum insured, premium and enrolment window depend on the applicable State/district/crop/season notification.

eligibility_rules.description: Farmers growing notified crops in notified areas may be covered if they have insurable interest in the insured crop.
Sharecroppers and tenant farmers may be eligible subject to State-notified documentary evidence and applicable agreement/land-record requirements.

required_documents.item: Evidence of insurable interest / land records / applicable tenancy or cultivation agreement
required_documents.note: Exact accepted evidence must be taken from the Karnataka notification for the relevant crop and season.

process: Check whether the crop, district and season are notified in Karnataka.
Check the applicable enrolment window, premium and sum insured on the official portal / State notification.
Apply through the official portal or an authorised channel.
important_current_notes: Do not show a generic premium or deadline as current. The official season-specific notification is authoritative.
The official PMFBY portal provides farmer registration and policy/claim information.
schemes.review_notes: Needs current Karnataka 2026-27 season notification by district, crop, insurer, premium, sum insured and enrolment dates before live recommendations.

name.en: Karnataka State Scholarship Portal (SSP) — scholarship directory

schemes.summary: A unified portal through which multiple Karnataka and Government of India pre-matric and post-matric scholarship programmes are administered by participating departments.

benefit.description: Benefits vary by department and individual scholarship. This directory record is not itself a single scholarship entitlement.

process: Identify the student's class/course, domicile, department/category-specific eligibility and academic year.
Open the official SSP portal and select the relevant department/scheme.
Confirm current eligibility, documents, application window and verification steps from the individual scheme notice.
important_current_notes: The Government of India's National e-Governance Division describes SSP as covering pre-matric and post-matric schemes for multiple beneficiary groups, including students from farmer, labour, weaver and other families.
Do not infer eligibility or scholarship amount from the SSP directory alone.
schemes.review_notes: Next research task: select one specific current-year SSP scholarship and obtain its official department notification / scheme specification. Do not use old university circulars as current eligibility authority.

schemes.summary: A merit-based scholarship listed on the National Scholarship Portal. Individual eligibility and current application status must be checked in the official scheme specification for the academic year.

benefit.description: Refer to the current official scheme specification; amount and duration are intentionally not populated until the current guideline is reviewed.

process: Check the current academic-year scheme specification and timeline on the National Scholarship Portal.
Check the student's eligibility in the official NSP scholarship eligibility tool.
Apply and track only through the official portal.
important_current_notes: The NSP page identifies the academic year as 2026-27 and states that One Time Registration is mandatory.
Portal announcements and application dates can change; verify the live scheme listing before advising a student to apply.
schemes.review_notes: Do not implement eligibility rules until the current 2026-27 official CSSS specification / FAQ is obtained and reviewed.
